questions.prompt: Identify two contrasting sounds in the introduction. How do their tones and rhythmic patterns complement each other?
How do the bass, chords and lead vocal work together? Describe the mood and identify a specific musical detail that creates it.
What changes in the arrangement or vocal texture? Explain how the changes maintain interest.
Describe how the instrumental and vocal layers develop. Which parts occupy the foreground and background?
Listen to the overlapping vocal lines towards the ending. How do repetition and independent melodies create a richer texture?
Identify one technique from this recording that you could use in your own composition. Explain how and why you would use it.
